title: Concept: Locked restore is switched off for the build
description: Directory.Build.props declares a `RestorePackagesWithLockFile` switch set to false, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads a `RestorePackagesWithLockFile` switch set to false.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Directory.Build.props (nuget).
risk: A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads a `RestorePackagesWithLockFile` switch set to false.
